name: Wayve
sub: Map-light end-to-end driving AI with $2.8B raised
regions: UK; Europe; US; Japan / global OEM evaluation
about: UK end-to-end AI driving company pursuing map-light, learned driving across vehicle types. Their thesis is scalable autonomy through foundation-model-like driving intelligence.
model: Technology licensing to OEMs and mobility platforms; robotaxi partnerships
financing: Late-stage private; reported $2.8B raised and $8.6B valuation
investors: SoftBank, Nvidia, Microsoft, Nissan, Mercedes, Stellantis, Uber
deployment: UK testing toward a London robotaxi launch with Uber later in 2026 on a camera-first, mapless stack; Tokyo pilot targeted for late 2026 with Nissan and Uber; Stellantis partnership integrates the AI Driver into STLA AutoDrive with first North American vehicles planned for 2028.
metrics: $1.2B Series D closed 25 February 2026 at an $8.6B post-money valuation, extended by $60M from AMD, Arm and Qualcomm Ventures in April 2026; roughly $1.5B secured including Uber milestones, about $2.8B raised in total. First automaker investors: Mercedes-Benz, Nissan and Stellantis.
signal: London robotaxi trials with Uber planned during 2026, first of 10+ cities; Tokyo pilot with Nissan and Uber targeted late 2026; consumer vehicles from 2027 starting at L2+.

sources.title: Wayve secures $1.5B to deploy their global autonomy platform ($1.2B Series D at $8.6B)
